## Research Question

Can defensive statistics in football (interceptions, fumbles forced, yards against, etc.) predict total wins in a season?

## Data Source

We are using NFL data from the SCORE Sports Data Repository. We are also using data from R studio in the "nflreadr" package.
Link to SCORE website: https://data.scorenetwork.org/football/nfl-team-statistics.html
